contents.name: Theorem1.80: Kolmogorov–Riesz–Frechet criterion
contents.reason: Source states criterion without proof. New helper supplies a direct complete CC sequence argument from finite cell averages, deterministic nested index bins and summable L1 differences. Do not attribute its constructive axiom proof to Terra.
contents.owner_inspection: Complete statement inspected; no proof is supplied at this location

contents.name: Definition2.3, Proposition2.4 and Theorem2.21: normalized Hausdorff gauge, Lipschitz control and ambient-dimensional equality
contents.reason: Terra inserts alpha(m)/2^m into the diameter gauge and proves H^m=Lebesgue. Repository uses unnormalised gauge; helper instead divides by proved positive c_m. No exact c_m or isodiametric theorem is imported.
contents.owner_inspection: Definition2.3 and relevant2.4 proof read;2.21 complete proof read;2.19 isodiametric proof not relied on or fully inspected

contents.name: Proposition5.9; Theorem5.12; Exercise5.13; Corollaries5.14 and5.16: Lipschitz weak gradient, Rademacher, Borel derivative and local/vector forms
contents.reason: Source Rademacher proof uses weak gradients and Arzela–Ascoli. Local helper gives a CC proof using interval a.e. derivatives, dominated difference quotients, cube Poincare and strong Lebesgue points; it does not import AC Rademacher.
contents.owner_inspection: Full5.12 proof and5.14/5.16 proofs inspected;5.13 is an exercise; page127 contains tail of5.9 only, whose Banach–Alaoglu route is not adopted

contents.name: Lemma5.27 and Exercise5.28: linear area and Jacobian bounds
contents.reason: Injective graph tangent linear maps are treated by orthonormal plane coordinates and the already proved CC linear change-of-variables result. No general singular-image area theorem is asserted locally.

contents.name: Lemma5.29; Definition5.30; Remark5.31: image and multiplicity measurability
contents.reason: For injective graphs, Borel images follow directly from graph homeomorphism, and null images from Lipschitz control. General multiplicity/Suslin claims are outside fixed scope.
contents.owner_inspection: Full5.29 proof and5.30 definition read;5.31 points to other works, not followed

contents.name: Definition5.32, Proposition5.33, Corollary5.34 and Theorem5.35: countable Lipschitz linearization
contents.reason: New proof explicitly partitions by rational derivative bins, uniform remainder radii and small cubes, avoiding arbitrary dense-set choices; tangent-plane bi-Lipschitz comparisons are supplied in source carrier.

contents.name: Theorem5.36: general area formula
contents.reason: Full proof read. Only injective graph positive-Jacobian case is claimed in helper; general multiplicity and singular-Jacobian case are not new library obligations in this repair.

contents.name: Corollary5.37: almost-everywhere countable fibers
contents.reason: Graph fibers are singletons, so this general conclusion is not needed.

contents.name: Corollaries5.38–5.39: weighted area and injective change of variables
contents.reason: Nonnegative weighted graph formula is proved from indicator identities and monotone convergence in the local helper.

contents.name: Example5.40(1)–(2) and Exercise5.41: curve length, graph area and local forms
contents.reason: Actual graph density and c1=1 supply Hausdorff/arclength identification used in disk example and smooth coarea. Local relative-topology Radon caveat is explicit.
contents.owner_inspection: Complete example computations read;5.41 is an exercise, localization is proved locally

contents.name: Definition7.30, Exercise7.31 and Proposition7.32: extended variation and L1 lower semicontinuity
contents.reason: Supremum/lsc argument inspected; arbitrary-L1 Radon membership is now supplied by new CC Euclidean representation lemma. Exercise7.31 is not taken as an unproved fallback.
contents.owner_inspection: Complete7.32 proof read;7.31 is an exercise

contents.name: Theorem7.39, Corollary7.40 and Remark7.41: epigraph trace, Green formula, compatible trace and strict continuity
contents.reason: Full7.39 proof read. Carrier uses direct mollification-collar estimates and cutoff Green identity, not source strict approximation/trace-continuity route. Boundary approximate-ball-limit and strict-topology trace continuity are not asserted by the local helper.

contents.name: Lemma7.42: rigid-coordinate invariance of BV
contents.reason: Rigid graph coordinates preserve volume, Euclidean vector norm and test-field derivative identity; complete source change-of-variables proof checked.

contents.name: Theorem7.43, Corollary7.44 and Remark7.45: global bounded Lipschitz trace
contents.reason: Full general-domain trace proof inspected. New local collar proof is patched finitely and supplies CC theorem; empty-domain and n1 endpoint companions are local additional direct arguments. Source printed262 variation-product equality is not copied.

contents.name: Theorem7.46, Corollary7.47 and Corollary7.48: gluing, bounded zero extension and matching Sobolev traces
contents.reason: Full7.46/7.47 proofs read. Interior/boundary singularity and unit-density variation are proved locally. General two-sided BV gluing and W1,1 matching trace theorem are contextual source consequences, not newly asserted claims.

contents.name: Theorem7.49: bounded-domain BV compactness
contents.reason: Both full source proofs read. Local route uses zero extension and translation plus explicit CC finite-cell sequence argument, rather than invoking DC metric sequential compactness.
